selected.rationale: The Fitness Enthusiast naturally buys protein bars as part of their active lifestyle. They have a category affinity for 'supplements' and 'functional_beverages', making them an ideal match for a protein bar brand targeting ages 18-45. They can be reached effectively via Pantrygood and Daily Form.

The Wellness Optimizer looks for evidence-backed nutrition and clean ingredients, which aligns with selling a better-tasting, premium grocery snack. They can be targeted on health-conscious publishers like Daily Form and Pantrygood.
The Convenience-First Millennial values speed and impulse-driven purchases, directly matching the fast delivery and snack-oriented profile of Swiftcart and the brand's mid-tier pricing.

rejected.reason: The Busy Parent prioritizes family-friendly products and kids' items in bulk, whereas this advertiser sells a single-item category (protein bars) with an estimated AOV of $30, which does not match their typical household purchasing bulk size.
The Gen Z Aesthete focuses heavily on beauty, fashion, and home decor with high visual identity, which does not align with the grocery and protein bar primary category of this advertiser.
The Pet Parent is exclusively focused on pet food, pet health, and pet supplies, making them entirely irrelevant to a human nutrition brand selling protein bars.
The Affluent Classic targets an older demographic (50-68) with classic apparel and home goods, whereas this advertiser targets ages 18-45.
The Sustainability Buyer focuses on complex supply chain transparency and refilables in sustainable apparel and clean beauty, which lacks a direct connection to a standard protein bar snack brand.

The Value-Conscious Shopper seeks heavy discounts and clear budget bundles, whereas this advertiser offers a mid-tier, one-off grocery product priced at an estimated AOV of $30 without a discount-first focus.

The Gifter buys specifically for gifting holidays and explicitly dislikes subscription-only or self-care-only framing, whereas a personal-consumption protein bar is typically an everyday snack rather than a gift set.
